problem: Public website chrome and NL/EN behavior previously had split authority across shared shell, static routes, runtime controls and page-local remnants, while chats could expose intermediate delivery state.
root_cause: The architecture lacked one explicit Powerhouse-wide authority contract tying website chrome, locale routing, cache versioning, production truth, agent/chat continuity and user-facing terminal reporting into one governed capability.
fix: registered publicLocaleAuthority under canonicalWebsiteChrome in the System Map
projected the contract into green assurance, continuity and system-map skills
bound the rule into AGENTS.md and chat/agent learning policies
documented terminal production and readback requirements
prevention: one shared site shell owns header footer mega-menu navigation and language switching
exact-main Netlify production and live browser roundtrip are terminal evidence
all chats and agents continue through terminal state without reporting internal delivery noise
